description: This file defines a compose-based UI component for rendering Markdown-formatted text in an Android app, including parsing, styling, and rendering various Markdown elements such as headings, code blocks, lists, tables, and images with Base64 data support.

classes.name: InlineStyles
classes.description: Data class encapsulating style parameters for inline Markdown elements.

classes.name: TableRenderRow
classes.description: Data class representing a table row with header flag and cell contents.

classes.name: ParsedDataImage
classes.description: Data class representing image data parsed from Base64 inline image in Markdown.

methods.name: ChatMarkdown
methods.description: Main composable function to parse Markdown text and render it with styles.

methods.name: RenderMarkdownBlocks
methods.description: Renders different Markdown block elements recursively.

methods.name: RenderParagraph
methods.description: Renders paragraph nodes, with special handling for inline images.

methods.name: RenderListItem
methods.description: Renders individual list items with markers.

methods.name: buildTableRows
methods.description: Constructs table row data from table nodes.

methods.name: readTableSection
methods.description: Reads a section of a table (header or body) and returns rows.

methods.name: readTableRow
methods.description: Reads a TableRow node and extracts cells.

methods.name: buildInlineMarkdown
methods.description: Builds annotated string from inline Markdown nodes for styled rendering.

methods.name: appendInlineNode
methods.description: Recursively appends inline Markdown nodes to an AnnotatedString.Builder with styles.

methods.name: buildPlainText
methods.description: Extracts plain text from Markdown nodes.

methods.name: standaloneDataImage
methods.description: Checks if a paragraph contains a standalone inline Base64 image and returns parsed image data.

methods.name: parseDataImageDestination
methods.description: Parses Data URL format image sources into mime type and Base64 string.

methods.name: InlineBase64Image
methods.description: Loads and displays a Base64-encoded image inline.
